continuous_supported_region.note: bounds of the declared visible extent in real-world (u, v) blocks on the plane - independent of the hypothetical grid below

export_convention.note: arbitrary local export choice, distinct from the continuous camera transform in transform.json. A single-region litematic always stores its shape local to its own minimum corner (Position is always (0,0,0) - a tested convention, litematics are meant to be relocatable), so the exported file's own coordinates are not directly the ones in evidence.json's supported_blocks; read-back verification accounts for that shift.

note: lateral_origin is an unresolved, arbitrary phase choice (see module docstring and transform.json's lateral_origin_is_assumed_not_measured); the supported_blocks/opening_cells in evidence.json are a hypothetical discretization at that assumed phase, not recovered exact cells - the continuous_supported_region above is the only claim this pilot makes without assuming a grid alignment.
